jobs.title: Spesialrådgjevar - avdeling tilskot
jobs.recommended_action: Two explicit MINIMUM requirements are not documented in the authorities: recent experience with state grant administration, and knowledge of the state financial-management regulations and grant law. The letter names this once, after the evidence, together with the supported ramp-up signal from BAR. No text repair remains. Action: At approval, accept that the application goes forward with this known gap. No edit is needed. | The employer requires the Jobbnorge fields for education and work experience to be completed, a diploma uploaded from Vitnemålsportalen, and references (attester) confirming position size. The deadline is 25.09.2026, one day away. Action: Fill in the fields and upload the documents manually when submitting. None of this belongs in the package. | The vacancy is written in Nynorsk. The package is in Bokmål by design and makes no claim about Nynorsk writing ability. Action: None, unless the candidate wants to address it in an interview. | Known limitation: Not documented: recent state grant administration (R02), knowledge of state financial-management regulations and grant law (R04), or grant case handling, recipient accounts control and recipient follow-up (R17). | Known limitation: Not documented: reporting to or dialogue with a ministry or other superior body (R13), and experience with voluntary organisations or Bufdir's target groups (R14). | Known limitation: Collaboration is documented only internally at OUS: a stakeholder process of about 50 people, workshops, and Power BI training beyond his own department. External collaboration is not documented, and whether the training went outside OUS is unresolved. | Known limitation: The allocation model was completed and handed over to controllers in early 2026. Its organisational use and realised benefits are unresolved. The text claims neither. | Known limitation: The views on how AI could be used in grant work are the candidate's forward-looking proposal. They are not delivered work and not knowledge of Bufdir's systems.
